data.name: When Games Collide
data.detailed_description:
When Games Collide is an online trading card game where exploration, collecting, and trading are as important as playing matches.

Explore towns and trade


Players explore distant towns for cards, miniatures, and other collectibles. Local card shops and player markets offer different cards and prices depending on the location. Players must visit a location to browse its market, and can buy cards in one town and sell them in another where demand is higher. Players can meet online in these locations to chat, trade, and start direct 1v1 matches without going through matchmaking.

Individual cards that cannot be nerfed


Every owned card is an individual copy with its own condition, ownership history, and match history. Published cards cannot be deleted or nerfed. Balance changes introduce new revisions while existing cards keep their original rules. Older revisions will stop appearing in packs, so players seeking them need to find existing copies. Cards acquired during Alpha and Beta remain in players' collections at public launch.

Build decks and play matches


Players build decks from specific copies in their collections. Each deck has a team designation. Cards from other teams cost two additional mana to play, while neutral cards have no additional team cost. Matches take place in arenas that resemble board games, where character cards appear as 2D battlers with a JRPG-style presentation. Ranked matches reduce the condition of every card in the deck, giving players a choice about which copies to use and which to preserve in a case.

Risk vs. reward


Ranked matches award in-game currency to both the winner and loser. Players can use that currency to buy packs or individual cards listed on local markets. Before a ranked match, players can choose a higher wear multiplier, accepting greater condition loss for larger currency rewards and increased chances of Rare or Mythic card rewards.

Locals, Invaders, and future expansions


The initial release is planned to include 96 cards across two sets: Locals and Invaders. Each expansion will introduce a new genre into the same game, bringing locals, aliens, fantasy characters, and others into competition for dominance.

Compete for control


Ranked leaders can choose a location’s genre styling and the types of rewards that drop or are available there during exploration. Competitive results therefore affect the places other players visit and the collectibles they can find.

Steam Workshop artwork sets


Players can submit complete card-artwork sets through Steam Workshop and use personal sets privately. These sets change how cards look without changing their rules or the individual copies players own. Selected community sets may also be released as paid cosmetic artwork sets after curation. If a curated set is sold, we plan to share revenue from its sales with its creator.

Features


  • Explore towns for cards, miniatures, and other collectibles.
  • Visit local player markets with regional availability and prices.
  • Chat, trade, and start direct 1v1 matches with other players.
  • Own individual card copies with persistent condition, ownership history, and match history.
  • Preserve selected card copies by casing them.
  • Keep cards acquired during Alpha and Beta through public launch.
  • Keep published cards and their original rules through balance updates.
  • Build decks from exact copies and play animated 2D card battles.
  • Combine cards from different teams in a deck, with additional mana costs for off-team cards.
  • Earn currency for packs and player-listed cards through ranked matches.
  • Choose greater card wear for larger rewards.
  • Collect 96 planned launch cards across Locals and Invaders, with new genres planned for expansions.
  • Influence location styling and exploration rewards through ranked leadership.
  • Submit and use custom card-artwork sets through Steam Workshop.

data.short_description: When Games Collide is a collection-first online TCG where every card is a unique, persistent copy. Build decks, battle for rewards, manage condition, preserve prized cards, and search local player markets for the exact revisions your collection needs.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Mínimos:
  • Requer um sistema operativo e processador de 64 bits
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 10 64-bit, version 21H1 or later
  • Processador: Intel Core i3-6100 or AMD FX-8350
  • Memória: 8 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or AMD Radeon R7 260X, 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Rede: Ligação à Internet de banda larga
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 4 GB de espaço livre
  • Notas adicionais: A persistent internet connection is required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recomendados:
  • Requer um sistema operativo e processador de 64 bits
  • Sistema Operativo: Windows 10 or Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processador: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memória: 16 GB de RAM
  • Placa gráfica: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580, 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Versão 11
  • Rede: Ligação à Internet de banda larga
  • Espaço no disco: Requer 4 GB de espaço livre
  • Notas adicionais: A persistent internet connection is required.
